title.narrative: Emergency Assistance and Support to Evacuations

description.narrative: ltpgtltbrgtThe Emergency Assistance and Support to Evacuations, coordinated by Team4UA, adopts an holistic approach to fill existing gaps in the evacuation from conflict zones along Ukraine's frontline areas to IDPs relocation. This project ensures that civilians from high-risk areas are safely transported to safe and inclusive locations enabling basic services and temporary accommodation. ltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtltbrgtThe project is built upon a Consortium of National NGOs led by a Team4UA with East SOS as lead associate, including Relief Coordination Center and Angels of Salvation as members. Local CSOs/NNGOs will be integrated as Consortium partners with capacity development after selection endorsed by the Consortium members, the Protection Cluster and the CCCM Cluster. The most vulnerable beneficiaries in frontline areas in need of evacuations prioritized by the Consortium members in the project are elderly persons, with disabilities or specific needs. This consortium will provide a structured, scalable solution that aligns evacuation efforts with the realities of daily operations, ensuring more efficient and safe evacuations as summarized below: ltbrgtlt/pgtltpgt1. Support for Local Partners:lt/pgtltpgtUp to 10 CSOs/NNGOs will receive capacity development to safely conduct humanitarian evacuations or support in collective sites. This support includes financial assistance for operational costs to the CSOs/NNGOs selected with training and logistical support tailored to the needs of each local partner.ltbrgt ltbrgt2. Collaborative Consortium Operations:lt/pgtltpgtThe project leverages a coordination platform between Consortium members to share operational planning and information, vehicles and premises. The platform also includes local partners with asset sharing related to the Duty of Care including life insurance for humanitarian workers and volunteers.ltbrgtlt/pgtltpgt3. Evacuation Process:lt/pgtltulgtltligtIdentification and Outreach: Relief Coordination Center will undertake identification of vulnerable civilians in active conflict areas and coordinate evacuation efforts through their activities under HAVEN Consortium funding. A dedicated mobile team in transit centers and a hotline shall inform beneficiaries about the evacuation process and settling in Collective sites through a project based booking system enhancing deduplication with external stakeholders and Governmental initiatives. lt/ligtlt/ulgtltdivgtltbrgtlt/divgtltulgtltligtSafe Transportation: Beneficiaries are transported by Angels of Salvation and local CSOs using secure routes and inclusively equipped vehicles to leave areas with intensive military activity. This includes coordinating with local authorities and humanitarian partners (RCC, East SOS, Team4UA) to ensure the safety of evacuees. People with disabilities shall be prioritized within the project to reach Transit centers before a transfer to their final destination in inclusive collective sites. lt/ligtlt/ulgtltdivgtltbrgtlt/divgtltulgtltligtCollective Sites: Once evacuated, beneficiaries are temporarily housed in collective sites. In the meantime, East SOS will enhance the availability and capacity of the collective sites pool through reception improvements in 21 collective sites. lt/ligtlt/ulgtltdivgtltbrgtlt/divgtltulgtltligtFeedback, Monitoring and Protection: The project integrates feedback mechanisms, including hotline calling directly a representative sample of beneficiaries reached, monitoring field visits between Consortium members and partners, ensuring that individuals assisted can voice their concerns and receive tailored support. This data is collected by Team4UA or Consortium Members and shared with the Protection Cluster and CCCM Cluster to improve future operations.lt/ligtlt/ulgtltpgt4. Post-Evacuation Support:lt/pgtltpgtltbrgtPsychological and social services will be provided to address essential mainstream protection as case management.ltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtThe project aims to establish a properly functioning, multi-step evacuation system that delegates responsibilities across to the Consortium members and partners. Each partner will have a specific role within the evacuation chain beneficiaries-centered for safe displacement from their homes to collective sites through transit centers. ltbrgtlt/pgt
